mirror.title: Sound familiar?

cards.text: You got a quote for $1,500 just to make one video. You didn't reply because that's your rent money.

cards.text: Your competitors are popping up on everyone's TikTok and Reels. You are invisible.

mirror.closingStatement: It's not your fault. The game was rigged against small teams. Until now.

howItWorks.title: We don't need your footage. We need your URL.

steps.text: Our AI reads your website like a Chief Marketing Officer. It learns your brand colors, best-sellers, and tone of voice instantly.

steps.title: The Strategy
steps.text: We don't just guess. Our engine analyzes top-performing ads in your niche to engineer creative strategies predicted to convert.

intelligence.title: We analyzed 100,000+ winning ads. So you don't have to.

pillars.title: The Trend Watcher
pillars.text: Our engine tracks what's working right now on TikTok and Reels. We use the audio tracks, pacing, and structures that the algorithms are currently pushing.

pillars.title: The Niche Expert
pillars.text: Selling coffee is different from selling plumbing. We benchmark your brand against the top 1% of competitors in your specific industry to see what offers are converting.

pillars.title: The Psychological Hook
pillars.text: We don't just cut clips. We structure every video with a "Pattern Interrupt" in the first 3 seconds to stop the scroll, followed by a psychological value anchor.

guarantee.text: We match your fonts, logos, and colors perfectly. If it doesn't look like you, we fix it for free.

items.question: Do I need to film anything?
items.answer: No. We use the images and footage already on your website or stock assets that match your brand vibe perfectly.

items.question: I don't know how to run ads.
items.answer: We give you the files ready to upload. We also send a simple 2-minute guide on how to launch them on Facebook/Instagram.

items.question: What if I don't like them?
items.answer: We offer one free round of revisions to tweak text, colors, or music. We want you to launch.
